name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Legacy trigger: context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction. Used only when compactAtTokens is 0.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Prune is skipped, context left as it is, below this visible character reduction ratio. The built-in summary is never requested.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

injectedMinChars.title: Injected text threshold
injectedMinChars.description: Harness-shaped text at least this long is scored using structural recognition; 0 disables it. Untagged user text and fenced examples are preserved.

replyMinChars.title: Long reply threshold
replyMinChars.description: Old assistant replies at least this long may be abridged to their opening and closing; 0 disables it.

maxPostCompactTokens.title: Visible post-cut token target
maxPostCompactTokens.description: Report visible conversation size against this warning threshold; never triggers summary; excludes system/tool prefix; 0 disables the warning.

compactAtTokens.title: Compaction token trigger
compactAtTokens.description: turn.complete requests a prune when the context holds at least this many tokens. Above 0 it replaces the percentage trigger; 0 uses the percentage.

targetVisibleTokens.title: Post-cut visible token target
targetVisibleTokens.description: The cut is tightened over cached Jev answers until the visible messages are at or under this estimate. Counts visible messages only, not the system and tool prefix; 0 disables the target.

handoffAt.title: Handoff order size
handoffAt.description: Visible tokens at which the plugin orders HANDOFF SOON, again per 50000 tokens of growth. Needs handoffDir.

handoffForceAt.title: Forced handoff size
handoffForceAt.description: Visible tokens at which the plugin orders HANDOFF NOW; raised to handoffAt if lower. Needs handoffDir.

handoffDir.title: Handoff directory
handoffDir.description: Each session keeps latest.md, resumed.json and prune_skipped.json in a folder named by its session id. A relative path resolves against the session working directory (one store per tree); an absolute path is shared by every session.

handoffSkillPath.title: Handoff skill path
handoffSkillPath.description: Path cited in the handoff orders; a relative path resolves against the session working directory.

logDecisions.title: Log per-item decisions
logDecisions.description: Opt-in diagnostics include kept and dropped call probabilities and text decisions. The outcome line is always logged.
